question: Proved true growth rates (side branches allowed) for the 226 families with growing ray bonds: uncapped least-fixed-point side table, depth-independent ray-summary graph, Karp.

public_inputs.code: written by Codex in codex/ from the spec; TRUE-BOND and PROVED-RATE code read-only.
public_inputs.run: codex/run_rate.py on the 226, launched by the thread.

forbidden_inputs: Changing the spec, predictions or decision rules after seeing registered results
primary_observable: lambda_true per closed family; zero cycles; the gate.
cheapest_meaningful_control: TRUE-BOND's exact L(s) (the gate) and PROVED-RATE's lambda_ray.
validation_gate: L(s) from the graph equals TRUE-BOND's exact values.

predictions.P2: no zero-weight trimmed cycle in a complete family
predictions.P3: 4 deficit-growing: lambda_ray - lambda_true = 1/2; >= 80% of the rest lambda_true = lambda_ray

stop_rule: Code by Codex; one run by the thread; a hand-off to the referee thread; report.
